methodology.core_selection: Available FanDuel alternate price closest to -250; ties select the more negative price.
methodology.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than Core.
methodology.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than Core, regardless of HR.
methodology.alternate_hr: Hits / 20 using the exact locked Stage 1 observations; FanDuel alternate markets use X+ thresholds, so observations >= threshold count as hits.
methodology.candidate_narrowing: Carry a player-market into Stage 3 only if at least one Floor/Core/Ceiling band reaches 14/20 (70%), the minimum historical HR for final portfolio legs. Choose Floor when it meets 70%; otherwise Core, then Ceiling. This does not change Stage 1 results.
methodology.excluded_analysis: No line/price movement, cross-book comparisons, steam, injury, weather, matchup, scheme, role, workload, or game-script analysis.
